findings.location: HTML paragraph containing the quotation from Luke 21
findings.source_quote: “Men’s hearts failing them for fear of things that are coming on the earth.”
findings.suggested_fix: Within the quotation, replace «من خوف وانتظار ما يأتي على المسكونة» with «من الخوف مما يأتي على الأرض» to avoid adding “expectation” and to convey the source’s wording.
findings.translation_quote: «تخور قلوب الناس من خوف وانتظار ما يأتي على المسكونة»

findings.location: HTML paragraph containing the quotation from 2 Timothy 1:7
findings.source_quote: “God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace «روح الفشل» with «روح الخوف» so the quotation conveys “the spirit of fear,” as printed in the source.
findings.translation_quote: «لأن الله لم يعطنا روح الفشل، بل روح القوة والمحبة والنصح»
